closing_balance.definition: The amount in the account at the end of the statement period, after every transaction in it.
closing_balance.example: The closing balance is 420 $, which is 80 $ more than the opening balance.

cognitive_offloading.definition: Using external tools to store, compute or retrieve information so that your own mind does not have to.

departure_gate.definition: The door onto the aircraft, identified by a letter and a number, for example B22. It is assigned late and can change.
departure_gate.example: My gate has changed from B22 to C4.

open_weights.definition: Publishing the trained parameters of a model so anyone may download, run and modify it.
